title: Perfect direct image of a tensor product with proper support
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes of finite presentation [def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Let $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ be perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], and let $\mathcal G^\bullet$ be a bounded complex of finitely presented $\mathcal O_X$-modules, each flat over $S$, whose terms have support proper over $S$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Then $$K=Rf_*(E\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G^\bullet)$$ is perfect in $D(\mathcal O_S)$, and its formation commutes with arbitrary base change: for every $g:T\to S$, the canonical map $Lg^*K\to Rf_{T,*}(E_T\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{X_T}}\mathcal G_T^\bullet)$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: The arbitrary-base-change assertion is Stacks Project, Lemma 36.26.4 (Tag 0A1D), applied with E as the perfect object (hypotheses of [lem-pc-rf-base-change-complex] checked: f of finite presentation is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by [def-pc-morphism-conventions]; a perfect E is locally quasi-isomorphic to a finite complex of finite free modules, so its cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent and E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X); the terms of G^\bullet are finitely presented, hence quasi-coherent, and a bounded complex is bounded above) and G^\bullet as the bounded-above termwise S-flat complex. Its canonical comparison is exactly Lg^* Rf_*(E\otimes^L G^\bullet) \cong Rf_{T,*}(L(g')^*E\otimes^L (g')^*G^\bullet) for every g:T\to S; since E is perfect, L(g')^*E identifies with E_T. Thus it remains to prove perfectness of K.

proof.text: Assume S is affine, S = Spec(R), and write R as a filtered colimit of Noetherian rings R_i. By Limits, Lemma 32.10.1 (Tag 01ZM), after replacing i, the finite-presentation morphism X\to S descends to X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i). The finite-presentation, flatness, proper-support, and perfectness descent assertions are exactly the combined Noetherian-approximation statement [lem-pc-noetherian-approximation-data], which packages Tags 01ZR, 05LY, 081G (with Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.26.7), and 09RF. Hence after increasing i we have a bounded finitely presented complex G_i^\bullet flat over R_i with proper support and a perfect E_i whose base changes recover the original data.

Apply the Noetherian perfect-direct-image theorem, Stacks Lemma 36.27.2 (Tag 0DJQ), to X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i), E_i, and G_i^\bullet. It makes Rf_{i,*}(E_i\otimes^L G_i^\bullet) perfect. Pullback preserves perfectness because a perfect object is locally a bounded finite locally free complex, and this local description also shows perfectness is Zariski-local. The base-change isomorphism of [lem-pc-rf-base-change-complex] for X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i) (finite presentation over a Noetherian base, hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated) along \operatorname{Spec}(R)\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i), as in step 1, identifies the pullback with K; the affine argument therefore glues over S.
